notes: HX Stomp is primarily a guitar amp/effects modeler floor pedal that also functions as a USB audio/MIDI interface; "Audio interface" was the closest fit in the provided type enum, not a full description of the product. Desktop/floor unit — not rack-mountable, rackUnits omitted. Port list and labels taken verbatim from the official Line 6 HX Stomp 3.80 Owner's Manual (rear/side panel diagram, items 10-18): INPUT L/MONO & RIGHT (1/4" instrument ins), OUTPUT L/MONO & RIGHT (1/4" "BAL/UNBAL" — same jack accepts both unbalanced TS or balanced TRS cable), SEND STEREO (single 1/4" TRS jack carrying stereo send, tip=L/ring=R), RETURN/AUX IN L/MONO & RIGHT (separate 1/4" mono return/aux-in jacks — can double as an always-on stereo aux input), EXP 1/2 | FS 4/5 (1/4" TRS jack for expression pedal(s) or up to two external footswitches via Y-cable), MIDI IN and MIDI OUT/THRU (5-pin DIN; OUT/THRU is one physical jack, software-switchable between MIDI Out and MIDI Thru function), Phones Out (1/4" stereo headphone), USB, and DC IN 9VDC 3A. USB is confirmed by the manual as "USB 2.0, multichannel, 24-bit/96kHz" (grade usb-2.0), but the manual's panel diagram doesn't spell out the physical USB sub-connector; it is a Micro-USB (usb-micro) receptacle per widely-documented product photography/teardowns, not verified in this text source directly — flagged as the one inferred detail. Power is an external 9VDC/3A DC adapter (center-negative barrel), not an internal AC inlet, so it's modeled as dc-barrel. This is the base HX Stomp; the larger HX Stomp XL variant has additional footswitches/expression pedal but the same rear I/O set.
